en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a busy waterfront scene. Numerous small wooden fishing boats are moored side by side along a quay. Women in traditional regional clothing and white bonnets, along with a few men in caps and uniform-like coats, stand on the quay and in the boats handling baskets and fishing gear, suggesting a fish market or landing of the day's catch. In the distance are industrial buildings with tall chimneys and gasworks structures, and further out on the water there is a small building on stilts or a pier and a sailing boat. The overall style and attire evoke an early‑20th‑century Northern European fishing town.
